intentEvidence: We complement this with a calendar view, making it easy to jump to other dates and see which days have notes.
problem: The standard daily notes view lacks a seamless way to browse through historical notes or easily navigate between different dates.

relations.evidence: Note that this plugin is standalone, and includes the functionality of the core Daily Notes plugin as well.

summary: Creates daily notes organized in a single infinite-scrolling page and includes a calendar for easy navigation between dates.
